evidence.notes: Identity alias row for the same no-render ApexPages.Message class exercised below.

source.content: @isTest private class UIApexPagesMessageComponentEvidenceTest { @isTest static void messageAndComponentContracts() { ApexPages.Action action = new ApexPages.Action('list'); System.assertEquals('list', action.getExpression()); ApexPages.Component component = new ApexPages.Component(); System.assertEquals(null, component.getComponentById('missing')); ApexPages.ComponentIteration iteration = new ApexPages.ComponentIteration(); System.assertEquals(null, iteration.getComponentById('missing')); ApexPages.Message summaryOnly = new ApexPages.Message(ApexPages.Severity.INFO, 'Summary'); System.assertEquals(ApexPages.Severity.INFO, summaryOnly.getSeverity()); System.assertEquals('Summary', summaryOnly.getSummary()); System.assertEquals('Summary', summaryOnly.getDetail()); ApexPages.Message withDetail = new ApexPages.Message(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR, 'Error summary', 'Error detail'); System.assertEquals(ApexPages.Severity.ERROR, withDetail.getSeverity()); System.assertEquals('Error summary', withDetail.getSummary()); System.assertEquals('Error detail', withDetail.getDetail()); ApexPages.addMessage(withDetail); System.assert(ApexPages.hasMessages()); System.assertEquals(1, ApexPages.getMessages().size()); } }
